detailedExplanation: This lesson contains 102 enabled questions. It teaches Passé composé activity bank through explicit translation, recall, grammar and application tasks.
Build the passé composé in two parts: choose and conjugate the correct auxiliary, then form the past participle. Check negatives around the auxiliary and agreement when être is used.
examTips: Underline every task requirement before writing and tick each one after it is included.
Build the verb and tense core first; then check articles, negatives and agreement.
Accents should be corrected and displayed, but a missing accent alone does not lose the app mark.
